decisions.statement: A generate naming neither a first frame nor a last frame is refused.
Two conditioning images with one file name are refused rather than staged over each other.
An extend's context window is fewer frames than the clip that window is pulled from holds.
An extend's whole length is a frame past four times a whole number.
An extend told no size renders at the context clip's own.
A seed nothing named is drawn and recorded with the run.
The recipe a generate or an extend ran under is kept as an inference run.
Nothing here starts the container or provisions the weights.

definition: the clip a wan call has the model make
